protocol.now: Corrected optional phase family fits all16 consumed courses but only1 admits both original held receiver readings. Never-filled computational S0 intersections currently use retained calibration bands only; drained calibration rows bind only the final forward check.
protocol.advanceToInvestigate: First test whether adding one newly declared calibration drainage reading causes the current finite producer to miss an admitted known course. protocol.sourceInputs: Consumed16 independently authored phase tuples, original broad retained bands, unchanged original surface and held rows. This is development evidence, not independent qualification.
protocol.acquisitionRule: For every eligible course append one original cumulative drained reading at the later retained calibration minute. protocol.primary: Count complete-original-calibration support and preserve every failure for oldband and optionalphase using identical augmented sources.
protocol.secondary: Score unchanged future held retained+drained rows only after parameter generation. No parameter or question selection from held outcomes.
negativeControls: Changed held values cannot change parameters or work

protocol.reuseAndOwnership: Reuse post-dry-receiving-inverse.js, unchanged rain/receiver kernel and original-account contracts. Public publication/claim writes remain uncertain and unretried.
protocol.method: At each unchanged rate start intersect the original retained S0 interval with every original cumulative-drained calibration band using D(t)=S0(1-exp(-kt))+I(t)-S_input(t), unchanged physical model; timezero is parameter-independent and remains in final check. No held value enters generation. Same9rates and2capacitywitnesses; complete9*(retained+drained) reservation.
